name: EMI Analyzer
description: EMI and EMC review of the open board: the layout causes of radiated emissions, ESD and immunity checks, and a cable budget. Runs locally; nothing is uploaded.
description_full:
Checks the board open in the PCB Editor for the layout mistakes behind most radiated emission and immunity failures: a trace crossing a gap in its reference plane, a layer change with no return via nearby, an unterminated via stub, copper close to the board edge, missing ESD protection, unshielded I/O and cable resonances. Click a finding to select its net in KiCad, or select everything flagged at once.

This plugin is a front end. The analysis, your boards and the results all belong to the EMI Analyzer desktop app, which you install separately and which runs everything on your own computer -- nothing is uploaded and the plugin opens no network connections beyond the app on localhost. Install it from https://github.com/embeddedci-com/emi-analyzer.

Requires KiCad 10.0.1 or newer with the API server enabled (Preferences > Plugins > Enable KiCad API). The first run installs PySide6 with QtWebEngine into the plugin's Python environment, a download of several hundred MB.
